title: Apple Watch Bracelet Model 1 (Wedge Strap, Mega Pavé)
materials: Treated Blue & Teal Raw Diamond Shards (~1.60 ct)

specs.case_compatibility: Apple Watch 44mm, 45mm, and Apple Watch Ultra 49mm
specs.strap_width: 26mm at lugs tapering to 22mm at buckle
specs.hardware: Solid Cast Silver Wedge End-Pieces with Recessed Raw Blue Diamond Pavé
specs.finish: Deep Matte Black Leather, Acid-Treated Silver Hardware

variants.name: Apple Watch 44/45/49mm Fit - Matte Black / Blue Diamond Pavé

shoot_prompt: A high-fashion commercial luxury watch accessory 3x3 contact sheet featuring the Apple Watch Bracelet Model 1 (Wedge Strap, Mega Pavé). Canvas layout: Exactly 9 vertical 3:4 portrait vignette frames arranged in a 3x3 grid, edge-to-edge full bleed, separated by crisp 1.5px solid white #FFFFFF borders. Studio Environment: Standardized neutral cyclorama backdrop in matte grey #EFEFEF, clean minimal stone surface with subtle soft contact shadows. Coherent 5500K softbox illumination, Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format clarity, f/8 depth of field. Product Specifics: Sculptural avant-garde Apple Watch replacement band in matte black oiled Horween leather, featuring solid cast silver wedge end-lugs embedded with raw blue diamond pavé (1.60 ct) and custom roller buckle. Mode: SINGLE_ITEM. Row 1 (Packshot Hero): Cell 1 (Front Hero): Frontal eye-level packshot of the watch bracelet curved as if mounted on wrist, displaying both silver pavé wedge lugs and black leather body. Cell 2 (3/4 Perspective): Three-quarter view highlighting the chunky sculptural lug integration and leather edge beveling. Cell 3 (Side Profile): Lateral 90-degree profile showing the 4.5mm thick leather profile and heavy silver pin buckle. Row 2 (Technical Details): Cell 4 (Overhead Flat Lay): Direct top-down flat lay on #EFEFEF surface showing strap laid out flat with precision laser-cut oval sizing holes. Cell 5 (Optical Macro): Extreme macro view capturing the vivid blue raw diamond shards clustered inside the acid-blackened silver wedge cavity. Cell 6 (Mechanical Detail): Technical macro focus on the precision sliding Apple Watch connector mechanism and security spring pins. Row 3 (Editorial On-Model Context): Cell 7 (Editorial Portrait): Frontal high-fashion editorial portrait of a model with hands resting calmly on knees, wearing the pavé watch strap paired with a smartwatch body. Cell 8 (Intimate Micro-Crop): Close-up crop at the wrist showing the raw blue diamond pavé glistening against skin next to the watch case. Cell 9 (Dynamic Lifestyle): 3/4 editorial styling shot capturing the rich contrast between high-tech watch glass and brutalist artisan leather. Strict Invariant: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO NUMBERS, NO WATERMARKS, NO GRAPHICS. Pure raw commercial photography only.
